text: ともだちが　かわいい　ポケモン　いっぱい　もってるの　…　くやしいわ！

structure.jp: ともだちが　かわいい　ポケモン　いっぱい　もってるの
structure.en: my friend has lots of cute Pokémon, you see

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows an ongoing state; here it is shortened to てる as in casual speech. もってる = 'has'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement gives it a soft 'you see, it's that…' feeling, common in girls' speech. もってるの = 'she has them, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ is a feminine ending that adds soft feeling to what is said. くやしいわ = 'it's so frustrating!'
